application.authority: Exact per-file snapshot hashes; git commit is supplementary provenance

provenance.integrity_scope: Frozen config/jobs/deadline scope and reporting input bytes authenticated; workers authenticate their complete frozen snapshot before execution.

definitions.success: status ok and native trajectory_outcome_met is true; no model completion claim is independently awarded credit
definitions.denominator: 120 cases per cell and 2640 declared episodes overall; aborted, unrecorded and deadline-not-started cases remain in cohort denominators
definitions.valid_native_episode: Native runner returned a structurally consistent status-ok episode, which may still fail its outcome
definitions.aborted: Saved infrastructure_error envelope; may represent model/protocol/context/budget/runtime failures, not necessarily scheduler or hardware failure
definitions.missing: No usable closed episode record; includes queued/running/unsubmitted workers, deadline skips and unusable records
definitions.offline_trust: Frozen scorer checks consistency and aggregates saved native grades; it does not re-simulate arbitrary reported outcomes

interpretation: Partial-coverage cohort rates are provisional lower bounds and must be read with attempt/native completion coverage.
Only exact production paths under runs/ in the declared frozen mode are included; development-smokes, development-qualification, older protocols and other modes are excluded.

Original proposals are graded before any teacher-forced correction. Assisted goal completion is distinct from autonomous success. native_score retains original-proposal, control/query, checkpoint, stage and intervention metrics.
Grouped scores retain every declared case in their original workflow/instrument/condition denominator.
No wall time, token count or native outcome is invented for an unwritten episode. No new model calls or significance tests occur.
